summary: Feed s082_single is degraded: 3.9% TCP packet loss (73 of 1886 packets) exceeds 1% threshold, breaking NDR flow reassembly. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, VLAN, truncation, tunnels, encryption, oversize, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: SPAN/mirror or packet broker ingress is dropping packets under load. 3.87% of TCP packets show gaps (73/1886) indicating buffer exhaustion/oversubscription at the SPAN destination or broker ingress, not at the NDR itself (tool_overload healthy).
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires complete bidirectional traffic with full payload for TCP stream reassembly and detection. Missing segments cause incomplete flows, failed reassembly, missed signatures/anomalies and evasion, significantly reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Passive TAP provides lossless line-rate copy without SPAN buffer overflow or broker oversubscription drops. Replacing SPAN with TAP (and ensuring broker capacity/load-balancing to 10Gbps tool port) ensures complete packet delivery for reliable NDR detection.
